Inspired by @PodvsEnemies Podcast vs Enemies episode 93 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0uYGSQqlyX1faCyATCDuno?si=IMSCRgTRQr-_THJdjxFMIQ) with @ImpetusAlways and @Saint_Kabr. First-choice PvE pick for burst damage against Major Spec enemies in end-game content. Uzume RR4 has very nice stats in it's subfamily, but the 50 zoom is either a blessing or a curse, depending on your viewpoint. Either way this is only worth keeping if you don't have a decent solar sniper, or it's better than the one you're replacing. The recoil direction of 75 is vertical, but if you're firing repeatedly at a crit spot it's still a good idea to control it with a boost to recoil direction or additional stability from your barrel perk. Handling is always nice to have too. Appended Mag gets you an extra shot - you can also use Alloy Mag or Flared Magwell to boost reload speed as your mag perk instead. In the first trait column as the support park, Fourth Time's The Charm or Clown Cartridge are pretty much tied - if you can reliably hit crits, FttC might get you an extra shot more reliably before reloading. In the second as the signature perk, Vorpal Weapon is the best of the bunch for a permanently-on +15% against Major Spec and Boss Spec enemies. Recommended MW: Stability or Handling, with a damage boosting (Adept Big Ones or Taken Spec) mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Uzume RR4 returns to us with some interesting rolls. Fourth Time’s the Charm and Vorpal Weapon are going to be your best neutral and solo picks. Golden Tricorn on Solar might be fun for short damage cycles. Precision Instrument is the worst damage perk of the three for me but pairs really well with Fourth Time’s the Charm for all the precision hits. Either way you slice it, having a magazine boosting perk is a requirement." Recommended MW: Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "In PvP things have shifted a bit, Explosive Payload feels like you have a better hitbox, but doesn’t actually provide any benefits other than shooting the floor for some splash damage. Vorpal Weapon allows you to one shot any super, which is helpful for Trials rounds or general PvP super fights. Snapshot Sights and as much handling as you can invest will make this sniper feel extremely strong." Recommended MW: Handling.

[YeezyGT's S16] [MW: Range/Handling] "Uzume has a few PvE options in; Snapshot for general use, Clown Cartridge/Triple Tap for extended damage. Explosive Payload should be your go-to here, with the exception of if you're running Triple Tap / using against Barrier champs, then you should look at Vorpal. Or if you simply don't like Explosive Payload, Vorpal's the play. Invest into a Handling barrel if you're not running Snapshot, and prioritise keeping the magazine high if you're running Triple Tap/Clown Cartridge." tags:god-pve
